title.narrative: ASEAN-EU Green Team Europe Initiative: Transition to a Regional Circular Economy

description.narrative: The Overall Objective (Impact) of this action is to promote a transition to a coherent regional circular, climate-neutral, and resource-efficient economy for ASEAN Member States. The action will contribute to increased advocacy, policy support, knowledge development and sharing, and awareness raising, particularly concerning plastic value chains, waste management, and waste prevention in line with circular economy principles.

The project’s intended outcome concerns the development and start of implementation of tangible initiatives of AMS governments and other stakeholders towards a circular, resource efficient and zero carbon economy at national and regional levels, through the coordinated adoption of ASEAN-appropriate circular economy policies, strategies, action plans, practices and techniques. The outcome is reached through the program’s two pillars: 1. Targeted regional policy dialogue on circular economy within ASEAN is strengthened, with the aim to identify focus areas, milestones and recommendations for an ASEAN Circular Economy Action Plan or Roadmap. 2. ASEAN and its member states’ governments (including administrations at both national and city/municipal level) in collaboration with the private sector and civil society organisations drive the CE transition by promoting regional coherent tools and guidelines for enabling waste data collection
Networking and knowledge-sharing of CE solutions with governments, cities, private sector, and civil society organisations in ASEAN will be a cross-cutting activity.
